title: Isandro and the Vow
author: Silas Blackwood
blurb: Sable Thackeray, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
